title: Jubilant Japanese Genmaicha Dumplings
description: A quick and easy Japanese dish featuring genmaicha tea and dumplings, perfect for a weeknight dinner. This shojin-friendly recipe is nutty and tender, with a delicate balance of flavors.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together the flour and salt.
Gradually add in the water and mix until a dough forms.
Knead the dough for 5 minutes until it becomes smooth and elastic.
Divide the dough into small balls and flatten each one into a disk shape.
In a large pan, heat the sesame oil over medium heat.
Add the chopped green onions and cook for 1 minute until fragrant.
Add the crumbled tofu and cook for 2 minutes until lightly browned.
Place a few genmaicha tea leaves in the center of each dough disk.
Fold the dough over the tea leaves to form a half moon shape and press the edges together to seal.
Steam the dumplings for 10 minutes until cooked through.
